title: Healthcare & Medical Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free HIPAA-compliant letter template to request access, correction, or deletion of your medical records. Protect your healthcare data privacy.
description: A comprehensive letter template to help you exercise your HIPAA rights and request access to, correction of, or deletion of your medical records. Includes proper legal language and formatting for healthcare providers.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
[Your Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]

[Date]

[Healthcare Provider/Facility Name]
[Privacy Officer or Medical Records Department]
[Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]

sections.heading: Subject Line and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: HIPAA Privacy Request - [Type of Request]

Dear Privacy Officer or Medical Records Manager,

I am writing to formally request [access to/amendment of/restriction of/deletion of] my protected health information (PHI) under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy Rule, 45 CFR § 164.524.

placeholders.label: Type of Request (access to, amendment of, etc.)

sections.heading: Patient Identification
sections.content:
Patient Information:
- Full Name: [Your Full Name]
- Date of Birth: [Your Date of Birth]
- Patient ID/Medical Record Number: [If Known]
- Social Security Number (last 4 digits): [XXXX]
- Address: [Your Current Address]
- Phone Number: [Your Phone Number]

sections.heading: Specific Request Details
sections.content:
I am specifically requesting:

[Choose one or more of the following:]

☐ Access to my complete medical records from [date range]
☐ Copies of specific records: [specify tests, visits, treatments]
☐ Amendment to incorrect information in my records
☐ Restriction on use or disclosure of my PHI
☐ Accounting of disclosures of my PHI
☐ Other: [specify]

If requesting amendment, please specify the incorrect information and desired correction:
[Details of correction needed]

sections.heading: Delivery Method and Timeline
sections.content:
Please provide the requested information in the following format:
☐ Paper copies mailed to the address above
☐ Secure electronic delivery to: [email address]
☐ Available for pickup at your facility
☐ Other format: [specify]

Under HIPAA regulations, I understand you have 30 days to respond to this request, with a possible 30-day extension if needed. Please notify me in writing if an extension is required.

sections.heading: Authorization and Signature
sections.content:
I understand that reasonable fees may apply for copying and mailing costs. Please contact me if fees exceed $[amount] before processing this request.

I authorize this request and verify that I am the patient or authorized representative. If you require additional verification of my identity, please contact me at [phone number].

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]

Enclosures: Copy of photo ID (if required by your facility)

useCases: Requesting copies of medical records for personal use
Correcting errors in your medical files
Obtaining records to share with a new healthcare provider
Reviewing what information has been disclosed about you
Requesting restrictions on who can access your health information
Getting documentation for insurance claims or legal purposes
Verifying accuracy of medical billing and treatments
Preparing for medical appointments or second opinions
